events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a defining moment of the counterculture era, took place over three days in Bethel, New York, starting on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibe
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people descended on a dairy farm in upstate New York for three days of peace, love, and music. The spirit of Woodstock still resonates today. What was the most iconic performance for you?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers the 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: King's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since we lost the King. Elvis Presley's influence on music and culture is truly unmatched. Which of his tracks still gets you every time?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The iconic lead singer of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman has delivered some absolute classics over the decades. What's your favourite?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and acclaimed solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock N Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! From Oasis anthems to his solo hits, he's still a true rock 'n' roll star. What's your top Liam track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's powerful anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK in October 1975, becoming one of the most celebrated songs of all time.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' was released as a UK single. Its message of peace and unity is as relevant now as it was then. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond's Best
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 007 first hit the big screen. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary co-founder of The Beatles and peace activist, John Lennon, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon moment?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is undeniable. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The music world remembers the incomparable talent and stage presence of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Queen's King
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the legendary Freddie Mercury. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched. What's your ultimate Queen anthem?
